description: Probabilistic voice router: at each evaluation a draw picks which of its six channels pass their input to their output, from a weight per channel and a target number of active voices

params.text: Sets how many channels take part in the draw, counting from the first; 1 to 6, growing to 16 when an expander is linked
Sets how many voices should be active after each evaluation, in whole voices, capped by the number of tracks taking part
Crossfades the density between the TRACK DENS knob and the DENS CV jack: fully anticlockwise the knob alone, fully clockwise the voltage alone
Sets how far the voice count may wander from the density target: fully anticlockwise gives exactly that number, and turning clockwise widens a gaussian spread around it
Sets how many bars pass between evaluations: 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16
Sets the chance that an evaluation is passed over and the channels keep their current state, 0 for never and 1 for always
Sets how long a channel takes to fade up when it is switched on, 0 to 10 seconds; it applies to channels in F mode
Sets how long a channel takes to fade down when it is switched off, 0 to 10 seconds; it applies to channels in F mode
Sets that channel's weight in the draw, 0 for never chosen and 1 for most likely; the menu's crossfade mode raises the weight to a power before the draw
Crossfades that channel's weight between its PROB knob and its PROB CV jack: fully anticlockwise the knob alone, fully clockwise the voltage alone
Sets what that channel does when it is chosen: F fades its input up and down over the fade times, G switches it through at once, T sends a short pulse and passes nothing else

inputs.text: Counts beats on each rise above 1V; a bar is as many beats as the menu says, and an evaluation comes after the number of bars LENGTH sets
On a rising edge above 1V it either zeroes the bar count or forces an evaluation at once, whichever the Reset input mode menu is set to
Sets the target voice count, 0V to 10V covering none to all of the tracks taking part; how far it overrides the TRACK DENS knob is set by TRK DENS XFADE
Takes over the evaluation period while patched, 0V to 10V stepping through 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 bars
Sets the skip chance while patched, 0V to 10V; with the menu set to binary it instead skips every evaluation while it is above 1V
Sets that channel's weight from a voltage, 0V to 10V; how far it overrides the PROB knob is set by that channel's PROB XFADE
The signal that channel passes while it is on; with nothing patched it reads the fixed voltage set on the menu, so the channel puts out a plain gate or trigger

outputs.text: That channel's input while the channel is on and silence while it is off, with the fade or the trigger applied, carrying as many channels as its input
A voltage for how many channels are on: their share of the tracks taking part scaled to 10V, or a fixed step per voice when the menu says so

notes: nothing happens until a clock is patched: evaluations are counted in clock pulses and the module has no clock of its own
a channel with nothing patched into its input works as a gate or trigger source on its own, because an unpatched input reads the fixed voltage set on the menu
the name beside each channel is an editable four-character label, double-clicked to type; it is drawn in its own widget, so no help line can be reached by clicking it
a channel's lamp is blue in T mode waiting, white for 300ms after a trigger, green while the channel is open, yellow during a fade and red while it is closed
the Maestro Expander 10 adds channels 7 to 16, and is linked from the expander's own right-click menu rather than by being placed beside this module
the small red lamp by OUT CH. AMOUNT lights when the 1.67V-per-voice mode is chosen with an expander linked, where more than six active voices push that jack past 10V
menu: Prob CV crossfade mode: Loose, Normal, Hard — raises every channel's weight to the power of one, two or three before the draw, so the harder settings favour the strongest weights
Beats per bar: 2 to 8 beats — sets how many clock pulses make one bar
Min active voices — sets a floor under the number of voices drawn, so an evaluation never leaves everything silent
Default input voltage: 1V (gate/trigger), 10V (CV/audio) — sets what an unpatched channel input reads, which is what that channel's output carries while it is on
Active output CV mode: Proportional to active tracks, Absolute (1.67V per voice, 6-ch scale), Absolute (0.625V per voice, 16-ch scale) — scales the OUT CH. AMOUNT jack
Skip CV mode: Probabilistic, Binary (on/off) — reads the SKIP CV jack as a chance, or as a switch that skips everything while it is above 1V
Skip mode: Global, Per channel — passes over the whole evaluation, or draws separately for each channel whether it keeps what it was doing
Trigger duration: 1ms, 2ms, 5ms, 10ms — sets the pulse length a channel in T mode sends
Reset input mode: Reset bars, Force evaluate — sets whether the RESET jack zeroes the bar count or forces an evaluation at once
